d.title: Seto no Hanayome Fan Disc
d.synopsis:
Fan discs containing shorts that weren't included in the TV series. 

1. Aoi Koi-hen
2. Ibara Koiji-hen

Each Fan Disc includes three shorts that are two minutes long.
Music videos from both discs are not included in the entry, as they don't contain any new scenes.

The same specials were also included in the Blu-ray box set.
